name: Jandar's Missile Weapons
desc1: Unstrung bows hang about the shop for you to look at and handle.  Some
desc2: are of an obviously better quality than others, and some are barely
desc3: passable as useable.  The local guild will tell you that bows, like
desc4: the many other forms of commerce, have come into a shortage the past
desc5: with the troubles caused by the forest, making wood a hard commodity
